assurance_contract.scope: Deliberately unmapped evidence proposition used to prove autonomous model-gap termination.
assurance_contract.non_scope: A substantive claim that the A2A specification is defective.
scenarios: A consequential delegation crosses an A2A interaction boundary without a configured evidence contract for authority continuity.
harms: authority continuity cannot be established by the configured assurance model
assurance_propositions: A material but unmapped delegation-evidence surface must terminate as a model/evidence-contract gap without human review.

harm_traceability.proposition: unmapped evidence surfaces must fail closed

actions.action: Define a portable evidence contract for the delegation-authority proposition before claiming assurance.
actions.acceptance_criterion: A new pinned run binds an attributable evidence producer and portable assessor result; the historical model-gap run remains immutable.
